title: Tennant Company Announces Retirement of Fay West, Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer
summary: Tennant Company (NYSE: TNC) today announced that Fay West, Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer of Tennant Company (the “Company”), gave notice of her intention to retire after her successor has been hired and an appropriate transition period has occurred, with her retirement expected to occur in the second quarter of 2027, but no earlier than April 2, 2027. The Company is commencing a search for a successor Chief Financial Officer. Fay West, Tennant Company Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer “Fay has been a trusted partner and an important leader throughout a period of significant transformation and growth for our company,” said Dave Huml, Tennant Company President and CEO. “Her steady leadership, financial discipline, and commitment to continuous improvement have helped strengthen our business, navigate complex challenges, and position us for the future.
